tagline: Delivering comprehensive risk management, insurance and consulting services worldwide.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted operating income (EBITDAC) reflects the core performance of the brokerage business model, significantly impacted by the integration of strategic acquisitions such as AssuredPartners, a major driver of structural growth.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDAC Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, and acquisition costs, divided by revenue.
kpis.description: The adjusted EBITDAC margin in the brokerage segment reaches 36.5% in 2025, an increase of 145 basis points, supported by the integration of AssuredPartners and Woodruff Sawyer.
kpis.signal: Margin expanding significantly due to acquisition synergies.

kpis.name: Brokerage Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from insurance and reinsurance brokerage services.
kpis.description: Brokerage segment revenues reach $12.2 billion in 2025, up 23%, driven by acquisitions and 6% organic growth.
kpis.signal: Strong organic and external growth in the core business.

kpis.name: Organic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding the effects of acquisitions and foreign exchange.
kpis.description: Combined organic revenue growth in the brokerage and risk management segments reaches 6% in 2025, indicating strong business model resilience.

kpis.name: Risk Management Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues from claims management, claims administration, and loss control services.
kpis.description: The risk management segment reports $1.6 billion in revenues in 2025, up 9%, with 6% organic growth.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in a specialized segment.

kpis.name: Total Adjusted EBITDAC
kpis.explanation: Adjusted profitability measure excluding non-recurring charges related to acquisitions.
kpis.description: Total adjusted EBITDAC reaches $4.5 billion in 2025, up 27%, reflecting the effectiveness of post-acquisition synergies.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in profitability following acquisition integration.

kpis.name: Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total market value of outstanding shares.
kpis.description: AJG's market capitalization reaches approximately $67 billion as of December 31, 2025, reflecting its position as the world's third-largest insurance broker.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: AJG has approximately 10,900 employees following the acquisition of AssuredPartners, strengthening its presence in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.
kpis.signal: Significant scale following the AssuredPartners acquisition.

kpis.name: Acquisition Impact on Revenues
kpis.explanation: Contribution of recent acquisitions to revenue growth.
kpis.description: The acquisition of AssuredPartners ($13.8B) and Woodruff Sawyer ($1.2B) was a major catalyst. The 23% revenue growth in the brokerage segment breaks down into +17% from acquisitions and +6% organic.
kpis.signal: Acquisitions are transforming the growth trajectory.

kpis.name: After-Tax Losses on Clean Energy Investments
kpis.explanation: Net after-tax losses related to clean energy investments.
kpis.description: Clean energy investments generated an after-tax loss of $5 million in 2025, a stable amount compared to 2024, and expected in 2026.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Economic and Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations, inflation, geo-economic fragmentation, armed conflicts (Ukraine, Middle East), and political instabilities directly impact insurers' risk appetite and clients' investment decisions.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is a key asset for attracting and retaining clients. Any reputational damage could materially affect new client acquisition and existing client retention.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: AJG acquired AssuredPartners ($13.8B) and Woodruff Sawyer ($1.2B) in 2025. The risk of failing to achieve expected synergies, losing key talent, or encountering technological integration issues could affect growth.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: AJG handles clients' confidential information (insurance data, personal data). A cybersecurity breach could result in financial losses, legal liabilities, and reputational damage.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Insurance brokers operate in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs and limit business models.

risks.title: Technology and AI Risk
risks.score_rationale: The inability to effectively apply technology, data analytics, and AI to create client value or improve internal controls could affect competitiveness. AJG is also exposed to risks specific to AI.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: The insurance brokerage market is competitive. New entrants, disruptive technology, or consolidation among competitors could affect market share and margins.

ai_positioning.summary: AJG recognizes the growing importance of AI and data technologies in its industry. The company identifies AI risk as a key factor and emphasizes the need to effectively apply technology, data analytics, and AI to create client value and improve operational efficiencies.
evidence: Item 1A: 'If we are unable to apply technology, data analytics and AI effectively in driving value for our clients through technology-based solutions or gain internal efficiencies and effective internal controls through the application of technology and related tools, our operating results, client relationships, organic and inorganic growth and compliance programs could be adversely affected.'
Item 1A: 'We are subject to risks associated with AI.'
